title: Defect Mapping Sweep
subtitle: Conduct and document a spatial visual inspection
introTitle: Build an inspection record, not a folder of pictures.
introBody: Move the camera footprint across Riverside Annex. Coverage only grows where you inspect. Capture a small set of spatially anchored images, revisit gaps, and leave a record another reviewer can follow.
provisional: Developed M2.1 learning material is not yet available. Scenario relationships and scoring are provisional.
mapHint: Click a surface cell or use the arrow keys to move the camera footprint.
finishHint: Move through at least six areas or record three captures before closing the sweep.
emptyRecord: No frames pinned yet. Each capture will remain linked to its source location.
feedback.useful: A distinct building feature is framed and pinned to this location.
feedback.context: This adds traceable context to the inspection record.
feedback.redundant: This frame overlaps a nearby capture. It consumes capacity without extending the record.
summaryPassBody: The map shows broad coverage and distributed, locatable evidence. Another reviewer can trace the record back to the building.
summaryFailBody: The record is incomplete or too repetitive. Revisit the building and use the remaining evidence capacity more deliberately.
